ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

2. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.

5. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

7. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.

8. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.

9. When learning Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism.

10. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.

11. When learning Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi.

12. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain D.C Electric Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cells and Batteries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
